Accomplishment
1. The First T.A. Playing in A Broadway Stage Show, the Leading Role of Thuy in “Ms. Saigon” 1993

2. Playing in a Number of Broadway Shows in Worldwide Tours

3. Premiered A Musical Concert ” Finding Home” about the Stories of His Parents, in the Annual Convention of Taiwan United Foundation in Los Angeles 2005 & Taiwan’s National Concert Hall and Vancouver’s Exploration Festival in 2006

4. Founded A Second-Generation, New York-based Theater Company Dedicated to Bringing Asian American Stories to the World’s Stage

5. Founded the “Concert of Excellence”, Now Presented as the “Asian Excellence Awards”, the Celebrate the Achievement of Asian Americans in Entertainment

6. Still Performs in Culture Nights and Annual Conventions of T.A. Organizations

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019

Notable Accomplishments

The first Taiwanese American playing in a Broadway stage show, the leading role of Thuy in 'Ms. Saigon' 1993

Playing in a number of Broadway shows in worldwide tours

Premiered a musical concert 'Finding Home' about the stories of his parents, in the Annual Convention of Taiwan United Foundation in Los Angeles 2005 & Taiwan's National Concert Hall and Vancouver's Exploration Festival in 2006

Founded a second-generation, New York-based theater company dedicated to bringing Asian American stories to the world's stage

Founded the 'Concert of Excellence', now presented as the 'Asian Excellence Awards', to celebrate the achievement of Asian Americans in entertainment

Still performs in culture nights and annual conventions of Taiwanese American organizations

Outstanding Taiwanese American elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019
